name: Unclean Food
overview: Scripture clearly distinguishes between clean and unclean foods, commanding God's people to avoid consuming anything deemed abominable or unclean, as emphasized in Leviticus and Deuteronomy. This separation was not merely ceremonial but carried spiritual significance, warning that eating unclean animals defiles the soul and invites God's judgment, as seen in Isaiah's prophecy of destruction upon those who partake in such practices. Ezekiel's testimony further underscores personal holiness in abstaining from meat that is unclean or has died naturally, reflecting obedience to God's commands.
